name: benchmark-msmarco
description: benchmark-msmarco is a collection built around the MS MARCO retrieval and question-answering tasks, measuring models' ability to retrieve relevant passages for real-world queries and to generate concise answers. It supports passage ranking and generative QA evaluations on large-scale web search-style queries, making it a standard resource for retrieval and QA research.
reputation: One of the standard large-scale benchmarks for passage retrieval and generative QA, widely used in information retrieval and QA research.
